name: Edmond
source:
Edmond's first meeting with Lillian wasn't exactly what one would describe as saccharine. He was initially meant to marry Lillian; however, this was a decision that her parents have decided for themselves. For this reason, Lillian thoughtlessly rejects his proposal before she could even get to know the guy.

Edmond isn't the type to hold grudges, which made it an easy task to mend his relationship with Lillian. He is willing to reconsider or forgive as long as you give him a good enough reason to do so.
